landmarks.name: Frosthold Bergfall
landmarks.note: A drowned ice-cut trough: deep water with a wall on either side and no beach at all.

landmarks.name: Moraine off Halereach
landmarks.note: A shaft in the ice that swallows a meltwater stream whole and drops it out of sight.

landmarks.name: Nunatak past Stormreach
landmarks.note: A bowl bitten out of a mountain head, usually with meltwater standing in the floor.

landmarks.name: Stormness Moraine
landmarks.note: Ice floating on sea, thick enough to stand on and flat to the horizon.

landmarks.name: Skerrybreak Saddle
landmarks.note: A stripe of scoured, treeless ground where the snow comes down every winter.

landmarks.name: Stormshore Horn
landmarks.note: A peak with three clean faces meeting at a point, and nothing above it for a long way.
